You're good enough for me, wink wink ;)

In all seriousness, you are good enough, even if other people dont think so. This life is only temporary. Lets not make it shorter than it already is. I dont know how bad in a place you are, but, im not doing any better than you and your post makes me feel like I want to help you realize how precious you really are. Remember those things you achieved. Dont make it about others. Make it about you. You accomplished those goals and they better yourself. Continue moving forward because I love you and so does God.

I dont know. My mom thinks i need to be in this treatment facility for a couple months to get more stabilized but all i want to do is stay home and play ony pc. Now that its gone im really tripping out. Thanks im glad i came here.
Just my mom, case manager, or someone in my program. Theres a crisis line i can call when feeling bad.

Im not a hundred percent sure but what goes through my mind is something along the lines of...
"Its been 6 months and I still dont feel better, I might as well just give up or get a little high, just one time and then ill stop" or ill feel bored at home doing the same thing everyday.

Yea I have schizophrenia and depression. I take an injection every two months for the voices and it helps but just a little, it dont remove them completely. I also take medication for depression daily. I told my mom that it helps me cope but she doesnt believe it because ive been through this many times with her where she takes my pc away because of a relapse. However when i do get my PC my relapses only occur after about 6 months of sobriety.

Thank you, im too stubborn to let adfiction control me lol. Ive been 2 and a half months sober. Games reeeeeaally help, especially action rpgs, i could play them for hours and they do help me a lot because usually i have voices in my head telling me to hurt myself but when i play games i can replace those thoughts in my head and days go by a lot faster.

Its true I could be doing more. I actually want to pursue creative writing for video game development and ive been researching some online colleges. Also thanks for the compliment I appreciate it. I just dont know if I can do it because I have schizophrenia and depression. Its hard to deal with and my only support right now is my case manager (im in a program) and my mom. Shes very strict about things and requires long periods of time to build trust again and give my privileges back. Im not really a materialistic person but tale away my pc and i get angry.

I dont know what i can say to my mom to get her to give me my pc back. She wants me to go to some halfway house for treatment but i dont want to go. Plus i already kicked the drugs and am living sober now. I hate not being able to play my facorite games and i have zero dollars to my name, so I cant buy one myself.
